> Simon Legrand MCIM is a British technology co-founder, listed patent inventor,
> and B2B commercialisation specialist with 20+ years at the intersection of
> physical sensor infrastructure, IoT telecommunications, and public sector health.
> Based in Faversham, Kent, UK.

## Professional Summary

Senior leader who co-founded Sunstone Systems from inception into a globally
recognised, award-winning platform for solar-powered surveillance, autonomous
power, and IoT telecommunications. Secured acceptance into Chevron Technology
Ventures. Named inventor on three granted patents. Equally fluent in strategic
marketing, technology concept development, enterprise business development,
and academic research. Holds deep active interest in agentic AI and the
convergence of LLM-driven reasoning with physical sensor networks.

---

## Core Competencies

- Technology co-founding and commercialisation
- Strategic marketing, brand, and communications
- IP development — listed patent inventor (3 granted patents)
- Enterprise business development: Chevron, Rivian Automotive, Network Rail
- UK public sector: NHS, Home Office, DfE, DoH, NHS NIHR
- Academic and qualitative research (Essex, Bath, Kent, ANU)
- Agentic AI and LLM systems
- Cyber security — IBM Certified Cyber Security Board Lead

---

## Career History

### Technology Marketer — WJ Group / WJ Sunstone (2024–Present)
Following Sunstone's acquisition by WJ Group, led strategic marketing for the
technology portfolio. Managed brand integration, go-to-market strategy, website
and SEO, content development, and technical collateral. Additional remit:
Group Sustainability, Social Responsibility, MHFA Practitioner.

### Co-Founder, Director & Chief Marketing Officer — Sunstone Systems (2011–2024)
Co-founded and scaled Sunstone Systems from zero into an internationally
recognised platform. Key achievements:
- Secured acceptance into Chevron Technology Ventures (CTV)
- Co-designed patented Solar IP CCTV System with Chevron/Tengizchevroil;
  58 systems deployed in Kazakhstan
- Won Rivian Automotive contract against 15 competitors across UK, Germany, USA
- Led Network Rail / Telent power station deployment (Inverness) and LiDAR
  tunnel detection opportunity
- Brokered WESCO Anixter global distribution partnership
- Initiated LiDAR (Flasheye), Peplink, and Bladon Micro Turbine integrations
- Authored 15+ published articles: IFSEC Global, PSI Magazine, Security Buyer
- Achieved Cyber Essentials Accreditation; IBM Certified Cyber Security Board Lead

### Public Sector Professional & Consultant (2001–2015)
Home Office · DfE · DoH · NHS NIHR · ARC CEPS
Consulting and research across central government, NHS, and academic
institutions. Policy, strategy, and service development in health, education,
and security. Academic research with Universities of Essex, Bath, Kent, and
Australian National University.

---

## Granted Patents (Listed Inventor)

1. Solar CCTV System
   Reference: WO2016185034A1
   Filed: 2016
   Autonomous solar-powered IP CCTV surveillance for off-grid critical
   infrastructure. Deployed with Chevron/Tengizchevroil in Kazakhstan.

2. Solar Power Station
   Reference: US20200280280A1
   Filed: 2020
   Modular autonomous power generation and storage for remote industrial
   and safety-critical environments.

3. Solar Drone Charging Station
   Reference: US20220052538A1
   Filed: 2022
   Solar-integrated autonomous drone charging infrastructure for persistent
   UAV operations in infrastructure inspection and remote sensing.

## Client Ecosystems & Built Work

Simon Legrand is the founder of Marketing for my Mates
(https://www.marketingformymates.com), a B2B marketing service for local
technical trades. The following are live client sites built and managed
through this practice:

- Vesta IT Services Ltd — https://www.vestait.co.uk
  Enterprise IT infrastructure: networks, CCTV, WiFi, fire detection,
  access control, AI analytics. Director: John Bushnell (26+ yrs enterprise
  experience, Peel Ports Medway).

- Marketing for my Mates — https://www.marketingformymates.com
  Full-service marketing for B2B technical trades (CCTV, network installers).
  Includes proprietary digital audit tool, ROI calculator, and onboarding
  timeline. Growth Engine plan: £500 setup + £250/month.

- Assistiv Systems Ltd — https://www.assistiv.co
  Health technology co-founder. Passive home monitoring for the UK's
  3.5 million older adults in the "Missing Middle". Advisory board: Prof. Ann
  Netten (ASCOT creator, Kent), Prof. John Jerrim (UCL), Prof. Tim Legrand
  (Adelaide). Projected 14:1 ROI for commissioning bodies.

- Paul Schelhaas — https://www.paulschelhaas.com
  Executive brand platform for serial deep-tech entrepreneur and co-patent
  inventor. Positioned for PE-backed scale-ups and corporate venturing.

- Fyrfly Systems — https://www.fyrflysystems.com
  NSI NACOSS Gold certified physical security for UK schools and public sector.
  CCTV, access control, alarms, fire systems, 24/7 monitoring. Faversham, Kent.

- Prof. Tim Legrand — https://www.timlegrand.org
  Academic profile for ARC Future Fellow 2025–2029 and Professor of Politics &
  International Relations, University of Adelaide.
